## The Problem

The National Cycle Network spans thousands of miles across the UK, but not all 
of it is equally accessible. Sustrans — the charity behind the network — wanted 
to better understand where the barriers to access lie and how they could be 
addressed.

This project was completed as part of the Data Study Group at 
**The Alan Turing Institute**, working collaboratively with a team of 
data scientists.

## Approach

We developed models to identify **access points** across the network and 
analysed the underlying geospatial structure using network science. 
Time-series analysis helped us understand how usage patterns vary across 
different parts of the network, informing where improvements would have 
the greatest impact.

## Tools & Techniques

- Geospatial data science (GeoPandas, OSMnx)
- Network science
- Time-series analysis
- Python
